features.quote: Sealing frame glue 13 is formed between upper substrate assembly 11 and infrabasal plate assembly 12, and irises out semi-enclosed viewing area A.
features.note: The sealing frame glue forms a semi-enclosed viewing area, which acts as a sealed space.
features.refuted: The quote describes sealing frame glue between substrate assemblies forming a semi-enclosed viewing area, not a first annular sealing unit with suction and external surfaces forming a sealed space when an adhering surface adheres.
